name: Wildfire
effect: Target city loses 5 Flock, and one neighbor loses 3.
flavor: A dry summer, a single spark, and the hills burn for a week.

name: Great Flood
effect: Every city in the target region loses 3 Flock.
flavor: The river forgets its banks, and three cities wake up underwater.

name: Tornado
effect: Target loses 3 Flock, and one neighbor loses 2.
flavor: It touches down in the square and doesn't lift until the next town over.

name: Earthquake
effect: Target loses 3 Flock, and one neighbor loses 1. Neither city can receive Flock next turn.
flavor: The ground splits, and the roads between cities go with it.

name: Avalanche
effect: Target loses 2 Flock, and every other city in the region loses 1.
flavor: The mountain lets go all at once.

name: Hailstorm
effect: Target loses 2 Flock, and one neighbor loses 1.
flavor: Ice the size of fists, and no roof that can hold it.

name: Wild Beasts
effect: Target loses 2 Flock, and its owner can't move Flock out of that city next turn.
flavor: Wolves on the roads at night, and no one travels.

name: Thick Fog
effect: Target and one neighbor each lose 1 Flock.
flavor: For three days no one can see the temple steps.

name: Strong Winds
effect: Move 1 of the target player's Flock to a neighboring city they don't control.
flavor: Some who flee the storm never find their way home.

name: Great Migration
effect: Target gains 5 Flock, and one neighbor gains 3.
flavor: Herds and families move together, following the god who called them.

name: Spring Awakening
effect: Every city in the target region where you have Flock gains 2.
flavor: The thaw comes early, and the whole valley turns green overnight.

name: Fertile Floodplain
effect: Target gains 3 Flock, and one neighbor gains 2.
flavor: The river rises gently and leaves rich soil where it falls back.

name: Sacred Grove
effect: Target gains 2 Flock, and every other city in the region where you have Flock gains 1.
flavor: Pilgrims come to the old trees and stay for the shade.

name: Shelter of the Wild
effect: Counter: cancel a Calamity just played on one of your cities, then that city and one neighbor each gain 1.
flavor: The forest closes around them like a cloak.

name: Gentle Rain
effect: Target gains 2 Flock, and one neighbor gains 1.
flavor: Not a storm, just enough.

name: Animal Guides
effect: Move up to 2 of your Flock into a neighboring city, then add 1 more there.
flavor: Follow the deer, the elders say, and you'll find the way.

name: Morning Dew
effect: Target and one neighbor each gain 1 Flock.
flavor: Every leaf shines at dawn.

name: Tailwind
effect: Choose a city where you have Flock. Take 1 of an opponent's Flock from one of its neighbors and add it to the chosen city as yours.
flavor: A kind wind carries the curious to new temples.

name: Famine
effect: Target player gains no Flock income for their next 2 Economy Phases.
flavor: The granaries are empty, and the faithful start asking whose fault it is.

name: Blight
effect: Target city loses 2 Flock now, then 1 more at the start of each of its owner's next 3 turns.
flavor: It starts as a few black leaves, and then it's every field.

name: Locust Swarm
effect: Target player loses 3 Flock from reserve. Anything they can't pay comes out of their cities.
flavor: The sky goes dark at noon, and the sound never stops.

name: Failed Harvest
effect: Target city produces no income for 2 turns.
flavor: The crop came in thin, and no one has anything to spare.

name: Drought
effect: Target city loses 1 Flock at the start of each of its owner's next 3 turns.
flavor: Each morning the well is a little deeper.

name: Spoiled Stores
effect: Target player loses 2 Flock from reserve.
flavor: Damp got into the cellars over winter.

name: Late Frost
effect: Target city loses 1 Flock now and 1 next turn.
flavor: One cold night in spring undoes a month of work.

name: Weevils
effect: Target player loses 1 Flock from reserve.
flavor: Small, patient and always hungry.

name: Rot in the Granary
effect: Target player's next income is halved, rounded down.
flavor: Half the grain is good. No one can say which half.

name: Bountiful Harvest
effect: Plant a seed. It yields 8 Flock at your next Economy Phase.
flavor: The whole city turns out for the reaping, and still they can't carry it all.

name: Season of Plenty
effect: For your next 3 Economy Phases, every city you control gives +1 extra income.
flavor: Three good years in a row, and the faithful remember who to thank.

name: Planting Festival
effect: Plant a seed. It yields 5 Flock at your next Economy Phase.
flavor: Songs in the fields, and every hand in the soil.

name: Full Granary
effect: Gain 3 Flock in reserve now and 1 more next turn.
flavor: Stores enough to last the winter, and then some.

name: Rationing
effect: Cancel one ongoing effect on you or your cities (e.g. Famine, Blight or Drought), then gain 2 in reserve.
flavor: Less bread for everyone, but bread for everyone.

name: Seedbed
effect: Plant a seed. It yields 4 Flock at your next Economy Phase.
flavor: Small rows, carefully tended.

name: Stockpile
effect: Gain 2 Flock in reserve now and 1 more at your next Economy Phase.
flavor: Put a little aside, the elders say, and it comes back to you.

name: Gleaners
effect: Gain 1 Flock in reserve.
flavor: The poor walk the fields after the harvest and find enough.

name: Early Sprouts
effect: Plant a seed. It yields 3 Flock at your next Economy Phase, or 4 if the city matches your domain.
flavor: Green shoots before the last frost.

name: Factory Explosion
effect: Target city loses 4 Flock and gets a Ruin token, which cuts its income by 1 until cleared.
flavor: The furnace went quiet for one strange second, and then it didn't.

name: Collapse of the Works
effect: Destroy every structure in the target region, and each city there loses 1 Flock.
flavor: One beam gave way, and the whole district came down after it.

name: Sabotage
effect: Target player's cards cost 2 more for their next 2 turns.
flavor: Sand in the gears, and no one saw who put it there.

name: Broken Roads
effect: Target player's Prophet can't move for 2 turns, and its next move costs double.
flavor: The bridges are out, and the Prophet waits on the far bank.

name: Mine Collapse
effect: Target city loses 3 Flock, and one structure there is destroyed.
flavor: They're still digging for the miners.

name: Machine Breakdown
effect: Destroy one structure in the target city. If it has none, the city loses 2 Flock instead.
flavor: The great wheel stops turning, and no one alive knows how to fix it.

name: Red Tape
effect: Target player's next card costs 2 more.
flavor: Every permit needs another permit.

name: Rusted Gears
effect: Target player's next card costs 1 more.
flavor: Nothing works quite as it should this week.

name: Stalled Caravan
effect: Target player's Prophet can't move next turn.
flavor: The axle cracked a day outside the city.

name: Grand Foundry
effect: Build: this city gives +2 income every turn.
flavor: Smokestacks and bell towers, side by side.

name: Railway
effect: Build, linked to the city's region: your Prophet moves between cities in that region for free, and each city you control there gains 1 Flock now.
flavor: The first train arrives, and half the region comes to see it.

name: Workshop
effect: Build: your cards cost 1 less while you control this city (maximum -2 from Workshops).
flavor: Every tool has its place, and every hand its tool.

name: City Walls
effect: Build: Calamities against this city cost the caster 2 more, and the city loses 1 less Flock from each.
flavor: Stone on stone, and the people sleep easier.

name: Repair Crews
effect: Remove a Ruin token, restore an Idle structure, or rebuild one destroyed since your last turn, then gain 1 Flock there.
flavor: By morning it's like nothing happened.

name: Market
effect: Build: this city gives +1 income.
flavor: Trade brings strangers, and strangers bring faith.

name: Paved Roads
effect: Build: moving your Prophet into or out of this city always costs 1 Flock, ignoring the domain wheel.
flavor: Even the far temples are a day's walk now.

name: Efficient Tools
effect: Your next card costs 2 less.
flavor: The new design cuts the work in half.

name: Surveyors
effect: Move your Prophet to any city for 1 Flock this turn without using your Action Phase.
flavor: The maps are finally right.

name: The Great Plague
effect: Target city loses 3 Flock. At the start of the target player's next turn, it rises from the discard pile, hits another city they control for 2, then goes back to the discard pile.
flavor: They thought it was over. They burned the bedding and opened the windows.

name: Barren Years
effect: Target player discards 2 cards from their hand (their choice) and loses 1 Flock in each city they control.
flavor: No children born in the city for two springs, and the temples empty.

name: Fever
effect: Target city loses 2 Flock, or 4 if another Health Calamity is in the discard pile.
flavor: It moves through the streets faster each time.

name: Contagion
effect: Choose a Calamity in the discard pile costing 3 or less and play it for free against the target.
flavor: Old sicknesses never fully leave.

name: Miasma
effect: Target player discards 1 card at random, and one of their cities loses 2 Flock.
flavor: Bad air rising from the marsh, and everyone breathing it.

name: Sickness of the Prophet
effect: Target player's Prophet gains 1 strike.
flavor: The Prophet falls ill mid-sermon, and the faithful start to wonder.

name: Withering
effect: Target city loses 1 Flock for each Health Calamity in the discard pile, up to 3.
flavor: Every past sickness has left the city weaker for the next.

name: Chills
effect: Target player discards 1 card at random.
flavor: A shiver, then a fog in the mind.

name: Lingering Cough
effect: Target city loses 1 Flock, plus 1 from the target's reserve if another Health Calamity is in the discard pile.
flavor: Never bad enough to rest, never gone.

name: Resurrection
effect: Bring back your removed Prophet or Hero with 0 strikes, and gain 3 Flock in their city. If neither has been removed, take any Favor card from the discard pile into your hand instead.
flavor: Three days in the tomb, and then the stone moved.

name: Fertile Age
effect: Target city gains Flock equal to half its current Flock, rounded up (maximum 5).
flavor: Every household has a cradle that year.

name: Remembered Prayers
effect: Choose a Favor card in the discard pile costing 4 or less and play it for free.
flavor: Old blessings, spoken again, still answer.

name: Midwives
effect: Target city gains 2 Flock, plus 1 more for each Health Favor in the discard pile (maximum +3).
flavor: Every safe birth adds to their reputation.

name: Cure
effect: Counter: cancel a Calamity just played on you, and put it on the bottom of its deck instead of the discard pile.
flavor: The healers find the cause, and burn it out.

name: Healing Waters
effect: Remove 1 strike from your Prophet or Hero, and gain 1 Flock in their city.
flavor: The Prophet bathes in the spring and rises clear-eyed.

name: Second Life
effect: Take a Favor card costing 3 or less from the discard pile into your hand.
flavor: What was spent is not always gone.

name: Herbal Remedy
effect: Target city gains 1 Flock, or 2 if a Calamity hit it this turn.
flavor: Willow bark and patience.

name: New Births
effect: Target city gains 1 Flock, plus 1 more if a Health Favor is in the discard pile.
flavor: A small blessing that keeps coming.

name: War
effect: Target city loses 5 Flock.
flavor: Neighbor against neighbor, and the gods' names on both banners.

name: Schism
effect: Target city loses 3 Flock, and its owner's Prophet gains 1 strike.
flavor: Half the faithful walk out of the temple and don't come back.

name: Fire in the Temple
effect: Target city loses 3 Flock.
flavor: The oldest scrolls went first.

name: False Prophet
effect: Target player's Prophet gains 1 strike, and the Prophet's city loses 1 Flock.
flavor: Another voice in the square, louder and easier to believe.

name: Heresy
effect: Target player loses 2 Flock from one city and 1 from reserve.
flavor: New ideas spread faster than old ones can answer them.

name: Bandits
effect: Target city loses 3 Flock.
flavor: The roads to the temple aren't safe anymore.

name: Thieves
effect: Target city loses 2 Flock.
flavor: The offering bowl is empty by morning.

name: Doubt
effect: Target city loses 2 Flock.
flavor: Nothing happened. That was the problem.

name: Scandal
effect: Target player's Hero gains 1 strike.
flavor: The Hero was seen somewhere a Hero shouldn't be.

name: Pilgrims Turn Away
effect: Target city loses 1 Flock, and its owner loses 1 from reserve.
flavor: They came to the gates, heard the rumors, and kept walking.

name: Bad Omen
effect: Target city loses 1 Flock.
flavor: A black bird on the temple roof, three days running.

name: Rumors
effect: Target city loses 1 Flock.
flavor: No one remembers who said it first.

name: Desertion
effect: Target city loses 1 Flock, and its owner loses 1 from reserve.
flavor: A few slip away in the night.

name: Brawl
effect: Target city loses 2 Flock.
flavor: It started over nothing, as these things do.

name: Divine Visitation
effect: Target city gains 5 Flock.
flavor: The god walks among them for one afternoon, and no one forgets it.

name: Golden Age
effect: Two cities you control each gain 2 Flock, and you gain 1 in reserve.
flavor: Peace, full bellies and full temples.

name: Pilgrimage
effect: Target city gains 3 Flock.
flavor: They come from every corner, carrying what they can.

name: Sermon in the Square
effect: Your Prophet's city gains 3 Flock.
flavor: The Prophet speaks, and the square goes quiet.

name: Hero's Triumph
effect: Your Hero's city gains 2 Flock, and your Hero loses 1 strike.
flavor: The Hero comes home, and the city spills into the streets.

name: Temple Offering
effect: Gain 2 in reserve, and target city gains 1 Flock.
flavor: Gold on the altar, and a few new faces in the pews.

name: Revival
effect: Target city gains 2 Flock.
flavor: Old believers remember why they believed.

name: Wandering Preacher
effect: Target city gains 2 Flock.
flavor: A stranger with dusty feet and a good story.

name: Answered Prayer
effect: Remove 1 strike from your Prophet or Hero.
flavor: A sign, just in time.

name: Feast Day
effect: Target city gains 1 Flock, and you gain 1 in reserve.
flavor: Bread, music and the god's name in every toast.

name: Omen of Hope
effect: Target city gains 1 Flock.
flavor: A rainbow over the temple, and everyone sees it.

name: New Convert
effect: Target city gains 1 Flock.
flavor: Just one, but one who brings their family.

name: Alms
effect: Gain 2 in reserve.
flavor: Small gifts, given often.

name: Testimony
effect: Target city gains 1 Flock, and you gain 1 in reserve.
flavor: One believer's story, told at every dinner table.

name: Crisis of Faith
effect: The Prophet questions the god in public. Their city loses 2 Flock.
flavor: "What if no one is listening?"

name: The Rival Preacher
effect: The Prophet debates a rival in the square. 1-2: lose 2 Flock. 3-4: nothing. 5-6: gain 3.
flavor: Two voices, one crowd.

name: The Long Fast
effect: The Prophet goes into the desert for 40 days. 1-2: their city loses 1 and the Prophet can't move next turn. 3-6: gain 2.
flavor: They come back thinner, and either wiser or broken.

name: The Merchant's Gold
effect: The Prophet accepts a rich man's gift. You gain 2 in reserve, but their city loses 3 Flock.
flavor: The faithful notice the new robes.

name: Vision in the Night
effect: The Prophet's city gains 2 Flock.
flavor: They wake shaking, and everyone wants to hear what they saw.

name: Forbidden Love
effect: The Prophet's secret affair becomes public. Their city loses 2 Flock.
flavor: Holy words sound hollow from those lips now.

name: The Prophet Wanders
effect: The Prophet leaves without telling anyone. Move them to a neighboring city (opponent to your left picks), and the city they left loses 1 Flock.
flavor: The door of the temple stands open, and the room is empty.

name: A Prophecy Fails
effect: The foretold flood never comes. The Prophet's city loses 3 Flock.
flavor: The faithful waited on the rooftops all night.

name: The Harsh Sermon
effect: The Prophet condemns the city's sins from the temple steps. Their city loses 2 Flock.
flavor: Some repent. More stop coming.

name: Healing the Sick
effect: The Prophet lays hands on a dying child. 1-2: lose 2 Flock. 3-4: nothing. 5-6: gain 3.
flavor: The whole city holds its breath.

name: The King's Summons
effect: The ruler calls the Prophet to court. 1-2: the Prophet is jailed, can't move for 2 turns, and their city loses 1. 3-4: nothing. 5-6: gain 2, and their city gives +1 income next Economy Phase.
flavor: Kings don't like sharing a crowd.

name: Speaking in Tongues
effect: The Prophet falls into a trance before the crowd. 1-3: lose 1 Flock. 4-6: gain 2.
flavor: Some hear the god. Some hear madness.

name: The Young Disciple
effect: A gifted follower begs to preach on their own. 1-2: they run off and take 2 Flock with them (lose 2). 3-4: nothing. 5-6: they found a following, so place 2 Flock in a neighboring city.
flavor: Every Prophet was someone's disciple once.

name: A Sign in the Sky
effect: The Prophet's city gains 2 Flock, and one neighbor gains 1.
flavor: A comet, exactly when the Prophet said it would come.

name: The Prophet's Feast
effect: The Prophet's city gains 1 Flock, and you gain 2 in reserve.
flavor: They break bread with beggars, and the beggars bring friends.

name: Pride Before the Fall
effect: The Hero boasts they need no god. Their city loses 2 Flock.
flavor: The crowd cheers the Hero, not the heavens.

name: The Bandit Lord
effect: The Hero rides out alone. 1-2: their city loses 3. 3-4: nothing. 5-6: gain 3 and remove 1 strike.
flavor: Some go to prove themselves. Some don't come back the same.

name: A Duel of Honor
effect: 1-3: lose 2 Flock. 4-6: gain 2.
flavor: Steel at dawn, and the whole city watching.

name: A Night at the Tavern
effect: The Hero's city loses 1 Flock, and you lose 1 from reserve.
flavor: Songs, wine and a broken table.

name: The Child in the River
effect: The Hero's city gains 2 Flock.
flavor: They didn't stop to take off their armor.

name: Deserters
effect: The Hero's city loses 1 Flock, and your next army can commit 1 fewer Flock.
flavor: Some soldiers fight for the god. Some fight for the pay.

name: A Challenge Refused
effect: The Hero turns down a challenge. Their city loses 1 Flock, and they can't fight next turn.
flavor: Wisdom or cowardice. The taverns argue about it for weeks.

name: Blood on Their Hands
effect: The Hero's last victory was too brutal. Lose 1 Renown, or if you have none, their city loses 2 Flock.
flavor: They won, and no one wants to say so out loud.

name: Wounded
effect: The Hero's city loses 1 Flock, and the Hero has -1 Might and Resolve in their next battle.
flavor: The wound closes. The limp stays.

name: The Monster in the Hills
effect: Something is taking livestock. 1-2: lose 3 Flock, and the Hero has -1 Resolve in their next battle. 3-4: nothing. 5-6: gain 2 and 1 Renown.
flavor: The hunters stopped going up there years ago.

name: The Tournament
effect: Champions gather from every city. 1-2: lose 2 Flock. 3-4: nothing. 5-6: gain 2 Flock and 1 Renown.
flavor: Banners from every god, and only one winner.

name: Rescue the Envoy
effect: A rival city holds one of your faithful. 1-3: lose 2 Flock. 4-6: take 1 Flock from a rival in a neighboring city.
flavor: Over the wall at midnight, and back before dawn.

name: Training the Militia
effect: The Hero drills the faithful. 1-2: an accident, lose 1 Flock. 3-6: your next army gets 1 extra Flock for free.
flavor: Farmers by day, soldiers by night.

name: Rallying the Ranks
effect: The Hero gains 1 Renown.
flavor: One speech, and every soldier stands a little taller.

name: A Song of the Hero
effect: The Hero's city gains 2 Flock, and your first roll in your next battle gets +1.
flavor: Every bard in the city knows the verses now.
